searchText: Is the Ethereum PoS chain vulnerable to a 51% attack or is it more complex than that? <@!105137469036474368> it's more complex 🙂 this is a good overview: https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/rkhCgQteN?type=view#Security-models In the table, they show the x axis in terms of network delay. What causes the network delay to go up or down? It's been a while since I read the whole thing, but I think it's basically a proxy for the stability of the network if for whatever reason, malicious or not, the network ends up being delayed by X amount, the table shows what happens I see thanks. This doc has so many answers to questions I have queued up in my head 🙂 Same! It answered a ton of questions I had when I was diving into the Eth2 spec 🙂
